name: Vespa City
summary:
Vespa City is a truly unique game. You can do whatever you want. From driving cars to shooting up gangs.  You decide what to do.

Story mode lets you climb from small-time hustler to someone the whole city knows. Every job, fight, and choice pulls you deeper into a life where loyalty and reputation mean everything.
